description: This Python source file defines API route handlers for a leadership dashboard backend, specifically related to file ingestion and folder mapping. It includes route definitions for uploading files, mapping folders, and listing mapped folders, using FastAPI, Pydantic, and Motor for asynchronous MongoDB access.

classes.name: FolderMapping
classes.description: Pydantic model representing a folder to be monitored or mapped, with path and alias fields.

fields.name: path
fields.description: Absolute or relative folder path to monitor

classes.name: UploadResponse
classes.description: Pydantic model representing the response after uploading a file, including filename and status.

methods.name: upload_file( file: UploadFile = File(...), db: AsyncIOMotorDatabase = Depends(get_database) )
methods.description: Handles file upload; stores metadata in MongoDB and returns upload status.

methods.name: map_folder( mapping: FolderMapping, db: AsyncIOMotorDatabase = Depends(get_database) )
methods.description: Adds or updates a folder mapping in the database.

methods.name: list_mapped_folders( db: AsyncIOMotorDatabase = Depends(get_database) )
methods.description: Retrieves all monitored folder mappings from the database.

ctags.name: alias
ctags.pattern: /^    alias: str = Field(..., description="Custom name\/label for the folder")$/

ctags.name: path
ctags.pattern: /^    path: str = Field(..., description="Absolute or relative folder path to monitor")$/

ctags.name: upload_file
ctags.signature: ( file: UploadFile = File(...), db: AsyncIOMotorDatabase = Depends(get_database) )
